basic_info.title: Jointly Contrastive Representation Learning on Road Network and Trajectory (JCLRNT)
basic_info.authors: Zhenyu Mao, Ziyue Li, Dedong Li, Lei Bai, Rui Zhao
basic_info.venue: ACM CIKM 2022 (31st ACM International Conference on Information & Knowledge Management)

gap_analysis.whats_missing: JCLRNT is purely a representation-learning framework with no map-matching or decision step, so the latent_space_RL_decisions pillar is absent. Its graph component is a GAT over road topology with contrastive objectives; there is no RDF/KG semantic enrichment of nodes/edges.
gap_analysis.reasoning: It combines a GAT road encoder with a Transformer trajectory encoder under three contrastive objectives (road-road, trajectory-trajectory, road-trajectory), covering the transformer+graph and label-free axes but with no sequential RL decision-making.

relevance.bmw_relevance: Provides a joint road+trajectory contrastive pretraining recipe usable for unsupervised embedding of fleet data; less directly about map-matching than recovery papers.
